wzti51f.name: Russia–Ukraine war

history.evidence: After a short-lived energy ceasefire broke down, Russia and Ukraine are trading strikes on each other's power infrastructure. Ukraine used more than 1,000 drones against Russian oil depots.
history.headline: Two killed and at least 17 injured as Russia and Ukraine trade blows on power infrastructure

w1f5pudc.name: Yemen war

history.evidence: Houthi missile strikes on Riyadh for a third straight day closed King Khalid International Airport and killed 13. Later reports describe intensified attacks on Saudi airports and oil infrastructure.

w594piu.name: China–Taiwan maritime confrontation

history.evidence: Sixteen Chinese vessels entered Taiwan's restricted waters in a single day before Taiwan's coastguard warded them off. This is maritime pressure and posturing, with no strikes or attacks reported.
